cited.quote: the Government has launched a comprehensive road scheme called the Tamil Nadu Rural Roads Improvement Scheme (TNRRIS)

rationale: C1 describes an existing rural roads scheme and ongoing programmes in a policy note. C2 and C3 are general policy notes. C4 and C5 are COVID orders, not rural economy measures. No dedicated order for new rural economy measures is shown.

cited.quote: The Empowered Committee will finalize the list of Panchayats for incentives after verifying the indicators.

rationale: C4 is a GO (2021-02-25) prescribing guidelines and an Empowered Committee and PMU for the Chief Minister's Rural Self Sufficiency Development Programme with Rs.100 crore sanctioned. A dedicated scheme and committee for rural development, which satisfies a directional commitment.

cited.quote: Memorandam of registered documents required for transmission under section 64 to 66 of the Act shall be automatically prepared

rationale: C5 is GO Ms No.106 (2019-07-25) approving the Tamil Nadu e-Registration Rules, 2019, a dedicated order streamlining registration in registering offices through an e-Registration module. C4 concerns digitisation of records only.

cited.quote: Chief Minister has inaugurated the Star 2.0
User shall enter the abstract of the document in e-Registration module for adjudication of a document.

rationale: C2 reports the STAR 2.0 registration project inaugurated on 12.2.2018, with online pre-appointment and a direct public-Sub Registrar interface, which simplifies registration. C5 is the later e-Registration Rules GO (2019-07-25). Earliest operational step is the launch in C2.

cited.quote: this Rural Sanitation Policy intends to solve the issues to sustain the ODF status
Special focus will be given to ensure all the new Households will have Safe Sanitation facilities

rationale: C4 and C5 are G.O.(Ms) No.13 dated 2020-01-06 approving the Comprehensive Sanitation Policy for rural areas, covering ODF sustainability, solid and liquid waste management and awareness. A dedicated government order laying down the framework for rural cleanliness.

cited.quote: No.68, RD&PR (CGS.1) Department, dated 16.06.2016
decided to accept the proposal of the Director of Rural Development and Panchayat Raj

rationale: C3 reports detailed guidelines issued by G.O.(Ms) No.68 dated 16.06.2016 for sanitation (IHHL) planning, motivation and monitoring as a mass movement, after the government took office. C5 shows the later Comprehensive Sanitation Policy approval (2020-01-06). Earliest dedicated step is 2016-06-16.

cited.quote: 16 Minority hostels are functioning at Chennai, Vellore, Krishnagiri, Coimbatore, Thanjavur
Hostel Buildings with Solar Energy System for Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes,

rationale: C1 shows existing minority hostels with amenities but no construction of own buildings for them. C2 mentions hostel buildings for a combined group of backward and minority students in a policy note, with no order specific to minority hostel buildings. C4 and C5 concern other hostels.

cited.quote: the Government hereby issue the following order regarding the determination of community and reservation in employment for the Third Gender
Target Population: All Transgender can directly avail multi-specialty services under transgender clinic

rationale: C1 is GO Ms No.90 (2017-12-22) on community and employment reservation for the Third Gender. C3 is GO Ms No.307 (2019-07-09) setting up specialty transgender clinics for transwomen and transmen. Both are orders implementing welfare measures; the earliest is C1.

cited.quote: the National Health Mission has been entrusted with the task of planning and development of Specialty Transgender Clinics

rationale: C1 and C2 are about transgender specialty clinics under the National Health Mission, a health service, not a specialised board or department for transgender welfare. C3 and C5 concern disability and C4 general health administration. No order establishing such a board or department.

cited.quote: spiritual and moral classes are conducted on all Saturdays in all important temples

rationale: C1, C2 and C3 are policy notes describing continuing activities such as spiritual and moral classes and special poojas. C4 and C5 are unrelated orders. No new order on the conduct of spiritual services in temples is shown.

cited.quote: the following grades of Executive Officer posts in temples have been created

rationale: C1 to C3 are policy notes describing existing temple administration structures. C4 (animal welfare board) and C5 (contract nurses committee) are unrelated. No committee or administrative step for temple spiritual services is shown.

cited.quote: This Government urges the Government of India to take concerted efforts to bring to

rationale: C1, the Governor's Address in the Assembly of 2017-01-23, formally states that the State Government urges the Government of India to act against those who perpetrated genocide and war crimes on Tamils. Judged as the state's formal urging step; a separate Tamil Eelam is not mentioned.

cited.quote: I also trust that the Union Government will take appropriate action to persuade the Sri Lankan Government

rationale: No Assembly resolution on freedom and self-respect of Sri Lankan Tamils is shown. C1 lists resolutions only on Katchatheevu, passed before this government took office. C2 is only a Governor's Address statement of trust in the Union Government. C3 describes refugee welfare schemes, not a resolution.

cited.quote: Science Labs, Hostels, Working Women Hostels, Compound Wall, Community Hall, Toilet

rationale: C1 only lists working women hostels among works the TAHDCO construction wing undertakes, without a sanction, location or coverage of all districts. C4 and C5 sanction other hostels (college girls and ITI students, a tribal school). No order for working women hostels in all districts.

cited.quote: in the Memoranda presented to the Prime Minister of India on 07.08.2015 and 14.06.2016, has urged the Government of India

rationale: C3 records that the Chief Minister's memorandum to the Prime Minister of 14.06.2016, after the government took office, urged the Government of India to implement the Pamba-Achankoil-Vaippar link. C2 and C1 add the 27.2.2017 memorandum and 24.05.2017 letter. A formal advocacy step was taken.

cited.quote: the Tamil Nadu Lokayukta has been established to inquire into allegations of corruption against certain public servants
the Selection Committee hereby constitutes a Search Committee for the purpose of submitting the

rationale: C3 states the Tamil Nadu Lokayukta Act, 2018 was brought into force on 13.11.2018 and the Lokayukta established; it is functioning with Chairman and Members. C2 confirms members assumed office and C4 shows the search committee GO of 2018-12-28.

cited.quote: advise Kerala to forthwith stop the construction work and not to take up any work in the Cauvery basin
The State of Kerala is restrained by a decree of permanent injunction

rationale: C2 shows the state formally objected to Kerala's Pattisserry dam work through the Chief Minister's letters to the Prime Minister and a Supreme Court application. C5 shows a Supreme Court decree restraining Kerala at Mullai Periyar. Outcome rests with the Union and courts and is not shown settled.

cited.quote: to distribute 764 Nos. of Agricultural Machinery and Implements namely Tractor
for an amount of Rs.7470.85 lakh as second installment share for the implementation of SMAM

rationale: C3 (GO Ms No.65, 2018-03-10) sanctions Rs.800 lakh for SMAM machinery in 2017-18, the earliest sanction after office in these extracts. C1, C4 and C5 show continued annual sanctions in 2020-21. The scheme was continued.

cited.quote: the Government have permitted the Principal Secretary / State Commissioner for the Differently Abled to send necessary proposal
orders were issued for increasing the percentage of reservation of differently abled persons

rationale: C1 is G.O.(1D) No.47 (2017-07-04), an administrative order on funds for the Maintenance Allowance Scheme for severely affected persons, continuing allowances for additional beneficiaries. C3 (2017-12-26) shows a further order on reservation for the differently abled.

cited.quote: 4% reservation of appointment in all Government establishments, Public sector undertakings, Boards, Corporations
Voice Activated Auditory Signals has been installed at 150 Traffic Junctions on the public roads in Chennai District

rationale: C2, the department's policy note dated 2018-03-04, reports ongoing measures (reservation, vocational training, identity cards). C5, the Performance Budget 2020-21, reports targets and achievements by scheme and year. Both are published reports on the upliftment measures.
